provenance.scope: Configurable system-level BS electronics model, not Jetson power measurements or a calibrated commercial AP. No site cooling, transport, edge-server or standalone UL-receiver power is included.
provenance.active_formula: P_active = 20 W + 6 W * unique occupied active-grid RE fraction + emitted RF power / 0.25. Empty but awake cell consumes 20 W. Full 1 W RF reference consumes 30 W.
provenance.active_coefficients: 20 W static, 6 W processing increment, effective RF conversion 0.25 and the 30 W reference are explicit project engineering assumptions; they are not absolute watt values specified by 3GPP.
provenance.sleep_scaling: Apply TR 38.864 category-1 set-1 relative ratios 55/280, 25/280 and 1/280 to the chosen 30 W active reference. This is an adaptation, not the standard's reference deployment or complete scaling formula.
provenance.transitions: TR 38.864 category-1 total ramp-down/ramp-up times are 0/6/50 ms and additional energies 0/90/1000 relative-power*ms. We scale energies by 30/280 W per relative unit and charge them once per wake. Total transition time is conservatively represented as no-service wake time; waking power is chosen at the 30 W active reference, not the TR sleep-state transition power.
provenance.duty_policy: 20 ms / 1 ms micro sleep and 100 ms / 10 ms light sleep are project experimental duty policies. They are not an implementation of NR SSB/SIB/RACH procedures or a standardized O-RAN E2 service model.
